paper_title: PyramidInfer Pyramid KV Cache Compression for High-throughput LLM   Inference
caption: Comparison between PyramidInfer and full cache baseline with different batch sizes on the LLaMA 2-7B model with input length of 512+256.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the throughput in tokens per second for PyramidInfer and Full Cache, compared across varying batch sizes. The x-axis, labeled ‘Batch Size’, displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 60, with tick intervals of 5 units. The y-axis, labeled ‘Throughput (token/s)’, also utilizes a linear scale ranging from approximately 200 to 2500, with tick intervals of 200 units. The pink line represents PyramidInfer, beginning at approximately 800 tokens/s at a batch size of 5, increasing to approximately 2300 tokens/s at a batch size of 60. The green line represents Full Cache, starting at approximately 500 tokens/s at a batch size of 5, rising to approximately 1000 tokens/s at a batch size of 60.
